parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description:
The ID of the configuration.
>Call the [CreateCycleTask](~~CreateCycleTask~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page when using paging.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page when using paging. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description:
The node name. Valid values:
- **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: virus scan.
- **IMAGE_SCAN**: image scan.
- **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: emergency vulnerability scanning.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:
- **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: virus scan.
- **IMAGE_SCAN**: image scan.
- **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: emergency vulnerability scanning.
